dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Insets: Miniature rail road map of the vicinity of New York. 28 x 20 cm.--The western portion of Long Island. 17 x 23 cm.
LC also has 1899 edition, for 17th annual report, c1900 by Colton, Ohman & Co.
Shows drainage, cities and towns, distances, and named railroads.
dct_title_s: Railroad map of the state of New York to accompany the twelfth annual report of the Board of Railroad Commissioners of the State of New York, 1894
